name: Matthew's Guide to Digital SAT Writing

mentions.name: Matthew's Guide to Digital SAT Writing
mentions.description: A textbook covering the Writing section of the digital SAT, released as a print book on Amazon after two and a half years of work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just released my SAT Writing textbook: https://www.amazon.com/Matthews-Guide-Digital-SAT-Writing/dp/B0G1BKCND2/ref=tmm_pap_swatch_0

It took me two and a half years to finish. Now I've got to market it.
